description: Live income and wealth tax (federal, cantonal and communal, without church tax) for ONE household in ONE Swiss commune, from the official ESTV tax calculator (tax year 2026): any income, wealth, married or single, number of children. For the tax on a CHF 100,000 salary in every commune at once (ranking, cheapest communes) use tax_by_commune.

children.description: Number of children in the household, e.g. 2 (default 0).

commune.description: Swiss commune: official name, BFS number or 4-digit postcode, e.g. "Winterthur", "230" or "8400". «8001 Zürich» and «Basel (BS)» also work.

income.description: Taxable gross yearly income in CHF, e.g. 100000.

married.description: true for a married couple (joint taxation), false or omitted for a single person.

wealth.description: Net wealth in CHF for the wealth tax, e.g. 250000 (default 0).

name: commune_tax
title: Tax for a household in a commune
